summary: ```markdown # MD Promotional Video: Composed of Natural Elements ## Introduction to Clow Clow is an incredibly intuitive design tool that allowed me to move the design of my spring-summer collection forward in the most incredible way. It enabled me to take the roughest of sketches and, through pattern drafting in 2D, really explore the shapes and fits that I wanted to make. ## 3D Rendering Revolution A truly revolutionary stage for me was taking these flat garment shapes and being able to digitally sew and drape them into a 3D rendering. Within minutes, you can see a 3D image of what you're designing and make alterations on those small decisions that make a design special. ## Material and Pattern Simulation Also, being able to look at the same garment simulated in different materials and different patterns was transformative. Then, seeing how those choices alter the drape, look, and spirit of a garment was truly revolutionary. ## The Impact of 3D Technology This is something that I absolutely love. It just hits you right in the head. It's a truly revolutionary design. For the size of my store, it’s really like a studio to give it your all. The state of the art is to take a glance at how much you have of this piece and go, "there's a great variety of stuff you can develop over the years to see how well it stands." ## 3D Pattern Creation So, the 3D rendering is definitely a Bothy style fabric, allowing you to see how different layers and designs come together. Making it a 3D pattern was really cool, and it's a clever piece that I’ve kept in my experience for years. ## Conclusion I think it's a really interesting model because it's such a beautiful design, but it's really convenient to have. It's a one-of-a-kind process that you can create on your own. I'll see you guys in the next one. Bye-bye. ```
